summary: Loudoun hosts 233 data centers. Data center tax revenue was approximately $1.2 billion in fiscal 2026, about 39 percent of the county budget.

source.citation: Washington Times, September 16 2026, attributing the revenue figures to the county website

notes: Described as the largest concentration of data centers worldwide. A county-funded Urban Institute report is cited for land values of $2 million to $3 million per acre for parcels zoned for data centers. For comparison, a Hillsboro campus parcel transacted at approximately $1.07 million per acre in September 2025.
confidence_note: County budget documents not read. The 233 count supersedes an earlier relayed figure of more than 250 and has not itself been verified against a county source. The Urban Institute report has not been read.
